# multipass_instance (Data Source)

Returns information about an existing Multipass instance without managing it.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "multipass_instance" "primary" {
  name = "primary"
}

output "primary_state" {
  value = data.multipass_instance.primary.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Instance name to inspect.

### Read-Only

- `cpu_count` (Number) Number of CPUs.
- `disk_total_bytes` (Number) Total disk bytes.
- `disk_used_bytes` (Number) Used disk bytes.
- `image_release` (String) Release reported by the source image.
- `ipv4` (List of String) List of IPv4 addresses.
- `last_updated` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last refresh.
- `memory_total_bytes` (Number) Total memory bytes assigned.
- `memory_used_bytes` (Number) Current memory usage (bytes).
- `release` (String) OS release running inside the VM.
- `snapshot_count` (Number) Number of snapshots recorded.
- `state` (String) Instance state (Running, Stopped, Deleted, ...).
